name: boldare-tech-tests
description: Self-contained verification harness for the Gatsby 5 upgrade. Deliberately kept out of the root package.json: it must be installable and runnable while the root tree is still Gatsby 2, which does not install on Node 24.

scripts.test:visual:update: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/tests -w /tests --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e BASE_URL=${BASE_URL:-https://www.boldare.com/tech-blog/} mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble npx playwright test --project=desktop --project=tablet --project=mobile --update-snapshots
scripts.test:visual:docker: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/tests -w /tests --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e BASE_URL=${BASE_URL:-https://www.boldare.com/tech-blog/} mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble npx playwright test --project=desktop --project=tablet --project=mobile
